     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_WPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_LetPair : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a)).

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
end.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm_tm a x A))).

Definition join_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi * g, A)).

Definition join_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g * psi, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi + g, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g + psi, A)).

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b)
 | G_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a c:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)
 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b)
 | G_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a)
 | G_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)
 | G_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
     Grade P psi B ->
     Grade P psi (a_Sum A B)
 | G_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm),
     Grade P psi a1 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a1)
 | G_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2:tm),
     Grade P psi a2 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a2)
 | G_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi b1 ->
     Grade P psi b2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)
 | G_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TyUnit
 | G_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TmUnit.

Inductive CEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
with GEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GEq_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GEq_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GEq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | GEq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | GEq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     GEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | GEq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | GEq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     GEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | GEq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     GEq P psi a a' ->
     GEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     GEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | GEq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Eq_SumFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A1' A2 A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A1'
 | Eq_SumSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A2 A2' A1 A1':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2'
 | Eq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Eq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Eq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a a' ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     DefEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | Eq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Eq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Eq_SubstIrrel : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (b1 a1 b2 a2:tm) (psi:grade),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      True  ->
      True  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  phi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      not (  (  ( psi  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
     DefEq P phi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a2 ) .

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm B' ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Sum A B) )   ( (a_Sum A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_Step_R : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( ValueType a )  ->
     Consistent a b
 | Consistent_a_Step_L : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not ( ValueType b )  ->
     Consistent a b.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     MultiPar P psi a a
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b1 ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive Value : tm -> Prop :=
 | V_ValueType : forall (a:tm),
     ValueType a ->
     Value a
 | V_TmUnit :
     Value a_TmUnit
 | V_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs psi A a)
 | V_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_WPair a psi b)
 | V_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_SPair a psi b)
 | V_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj1 a)
 | V_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj2 a).

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=

     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)

     lc_tm A ->

 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),

     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a

 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->

 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->

      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->

 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->

 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_WPairBeta : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 b2 a1' a2':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->

     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a1' )   q_Bot  a2')

      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a1' a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) a1'
 | Par_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) a2
 | Par_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     Par P psi A1 A1' ->
     Par P psi A2 A2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Par_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 a1' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Par_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     Par P psi a2 a2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Par_CaseBeta1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b1' a' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b1' psi0 a')
 | Par_CaseBeta2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b2' a' b1':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b2' psi0 a')
 | Par_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2').

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     MultiPar P psi a a
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/task_head <<'EOF'
Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Relations Relation_Operators.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Type constructors are represented by distinct constants in a lambda
   calculus. Runtime eliminators will use ordinary beta conversion. *)
Inductive consistency_constant : Set :=
| ct_type : sort -> consistency_constant
| ct_unit : consistency_constant
| ct_pi : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_wsigma : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_ssigma : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_sum : consistency_constant
| ct_dummy : consistency_constant.

Inductive code : Set :=
| cv : nat -> code
| cc : consistency_constant -> code
| cl : code -> code
| ca : code -> code -> code.

Definition push {X : Type} (x : X) (f : nat -> X) (n : nat) :=
  match n with O => x | S m => f m end.

Fixpoint rename_code (f : nat -> nat) (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cv n => cv (f n)
  | cc c => cc c
  | cl b => cl (rename_code (push O (fun n => S (f n))) b)
  | ca a b => ca (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b)
  end.

Definition lift_code (f : nat -> code) :=
  push (cv 0) (fun n => rename_code S (f n)).

Fixpoint subst_code (f : nat -> code) (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cv n => f n
  | cc c => cc c
  | cl b => cl (subst_code (lift_code f) b)
  | ca a b => ca (subst_code f a) (subst_code f b)
  end.

Definition apply_body (b a : code) := subst_code (push a cv) b.

Local Lemma rename_code_ext : forall t f g,
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> rename_code f t = rename_code g t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g H; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  apply IHt. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_ext : forall t f g,
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> subst_code f t = subst_code g t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g H; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  apply IHt. intros [|n]; simpl; auto. now rewrite H.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_code_comp : forall t f g,
  rename_code f (rename_code g t) = rename_code (fun n => f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply rename_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_rename_code : forall t f g,
  subst_code f (rename_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_subst_code : forall t f g,
  rename_code f (subst_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => rename_code f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  now rewrite "'!rename_code_comp.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_comp : forall t f g,
  subst_code f (subst_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => subst_code f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  now rewrite subst_rename_code, rename_subst_code.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_id : forall t, subst_code cv t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite <- IHt at 2 || idtac.
  transitivity (subst_code cv t); [|exact IHt].
  apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_unshift : forall a t,
  subst_code (push a cv) (rename_code S t) = t.
Proof. intros; rewrite subst_rename_code; apply subst_code_id. Qed.

Local Lemma subst_apply_body : forall b a f,
  subst_code f (apply_body b a) =
  apply_body (subst_code (lift_code f) b) (subst_code f a).
Proof.
  intros; unfold apply_body. rewrite !subst_code_comp.
  apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  symmetry. apply subst_code_unshift.
Qed.

Inductive code_parallel : code -> code -> Prop :=
| cp_var : forall n, code_parallel (cv n) (cv n)
| cp_const : forall c, code_parallel (cc c) (cc c)
| cp_lam : forall b b'"', code_parallel b b' -> code_parallel (cl b) (cl b')
| cp_app : forall a a' b b',
    code_parallel a a' -> code_parallel b b' ->
    code_parallel (ca a b) (ca a' b')
| cp_beta : forall b b' a a',
    code_parallel b b' -> code_parallel a a' ->
    code_parallel (ca (cl b) a) (apply_body b' a').

Local Hint Constructors code_parallel : code.
Local Lemma code_parallel_refl : forall t, code_parallel t t.
Proof. induction t; auto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_parallel_refl : code.

Local Lemma code_parallel_rename : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> forall f, code_parallel (rename_code f t) (rename_code f u).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros f; simpl; auto with code.
  unfold apply_body. rewrite rename_subst_code.
  replace (subst_code (fun n => rename_code f (push a' cv n)) b')
    with (apply_body (rename_code (push 0 (fun n => S (f n))) b') (rename_code f a')).
  - auto with code.
  - unfold apply_body. rewrite subst_rename_code.
    apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma code_parallel_subst : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> forall f g,
  (forall n, code_parallel (f n) (g n)) ->
  code_parallel (subst_code f t) (subst_code g u).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros f g Hfg; simpl; auto with code.
  - apply cp_lam, IHcode_parallel. intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
    now apply code_parallel_rename.
  - rewrite subst_apply_body. apply cp_beta; auto.
    apply IHcode_parallel1. intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
    now apply code_parallel_rename.
Qed.

Fixpoint develop_code (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cl b => cl (develop_code b)
  | ca (cl b) a => apply_body (develop_code b) (develop_code a)
  | ca f a => ca (develop_code f) (develop_code a)
  | t => t
  end.

Local Lemma develop_code_spec : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> code_parallel u (develop_code t).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; simpl; auto with code.
  - destruct a; simpl in *; auto with code.
    inversion H; subst. inversion IHcode_parallel1; subst. auto with code.
  - unfold apply_body. apply code_parallel_subst; auto.
    intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_parallel_diamond : forall t a b,
  code_parallel t a -> code_parallel t b ->
  exists c, code_parallel a c /\\ code_parallel b c.
Proof. intros; exists (develop_code t); auto using develop_code_spec. Qed.

Local Definition code_steps := clos_refl_trans_1n code code_parallel.
Local Definition code_eq (a b : code) :=
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_steps b c.

Local Hint Constructors clos_refl_trans_1n : code.

Local Lemma code_steps_trans : forall a b c,
  code_steps a b -> code_steps b c -> code_steps a c.
Proof. intros a b c H; induction H; eauto with code. Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_strip : forall t a b,
  code_parallel t a -> code_steps t b ->
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_parallel b c.
Proof.
  intros t a b Ha Hb. revert a Ha. induction Hb; intros a Ha.
  - exists a; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_parallel_diamond Ha H) as (d & Had & Hyd).
    destruct (IHHb _ Hyd) as (e & Hde & Hze). exists e; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_confluent : forall t a b,
  code_steps t a -> code_steps t b ->
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_steps b c.
Proof.
  intros t a b Ha; revert b; induction Ha; intros b Hb.
  - exists b; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_steps_strip H Hb) as (d & Hyd & Hbd).
    destruct (IHHa _ Hyd) as (e & Hze & Hde). exists e; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_refl : forall a, code_eq a a.
Proof. unfold code_eq; eauto with code. Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_sym : forall a b, code_eq a b -> code_eq b a.
Proof. unfold code_eq; firstorder. Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_trans : forall a b c,
  code_eq a b -> code_eq b c -> code_eq a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c (d & Had & Hbd) (e & Hbe & Hce).
  destruct (code_steps_confluent Hbd Hbe) as (f & Hdf & Hef).
  exists f; eauto using code_steps_trans.
Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_parallel : forall a b, code_parallel a b -> code_eq a b.
Proof. intros; exists b; eauto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_eq_refl code_eq_parallel : code.

Local Lemma code_steps_lam : forall a b, code_steps a b ->
  code_steps (cl a) (cl b).
Proof. intros a b H; induction H; eauto with code. Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_app : forall a a' b b',
  code_steps a a' -> code_steps b b' -> code_steps (ca a b) (ca a' b').
Proof.
  intros a a' b b' Ha Hb. induction Ha.
  - induction Hb; eauto with code.
  - eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_lam : forall a b, code_eq a b -> code_eq (cl a) (cl b).
Proof. intros a b (c & Hac & Hbc); exists (cl c); auto using code_steps_lam. Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_app : forall a a' b b',
  code_eq a a' -> code_eq b b' -> code_eq (ca a b) (ca a' b').
Proof.
  intros a a' b b' (c & Hac & Hac') (d & Hbd & Hbd').
  exists (ca c d); auto using code_steps_app.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_rename : forall a b,
  code_eq a b -> forall f, code_eq (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b).
Proof.
  assert (H : forall a b, code_steps a b -> forall f,
    code_steps (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b)).
  { intros a b H; induction H; eauto using code_parallel_rename with code. }
  intros a b (c & Hac & Hbc) f. exists (rename_code f c); auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_beta : forall b a, code_eq (ca (cl b) a) (apply_body b a).
Proof. auto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_eq_lam code_eq_app code_eq_rename code_eq_beta : code.

(* A constant and its left-associated arguments survive every reduction.
   This gives both discrimination and injectivity for type constructors. *)
Fixpoint spine (c : consistency_constant) (args : list code) : code :=
  match args with
  | nil => cc c
  | a :: rest => ca (spine c rest) a
  end.

Local Lemma code_parallel_spine : forall args c u,
  code_parallel (spine c args) u ->
  exists args', u = spine c args' /\\ Forall2 code_parallel args args'.
Proof.
  induction args as [|a args IH]; intros c u H; simpl in H.
  - inversion H; subst. exists nil; auto.
  - destruct args; inversion H; subst;
      try solve [destruct args; discriminate].
    all: match goal with
    | Hp : code_parallel (spine _ _) _ |- _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    | Hp : code_parallel (cc _) _ |- _ =>
        change (code_parallel (spine c nil) _) in Hp;
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    | Hp : code_parallel (ca (spine _ _) _) _ |- _ =>
        change (code_parallel (spine c (_ :: _)) _) in Hp;
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    end.
    all: eexists (_ :: args'); split; [reflexivity|constructor; assumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_spine : forall t u, code_steps t u ->
  forall c args, t = spine c args ->
  exists args', u = spine c args' /\\ Forall2 code_steps args args'.
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros c args ->.
  - exists args; split; auto. induction args; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_parallel_spine args H) as (args' & Heq & Hpar).
    destruct (IHclos_refl_trans_1n _ _ Heq) as (args'' & -> & Hmulti).
    exists args''; split; auto.
    revert args'' Hmulti. induction Hpar; intros args'' Hmulti;
      inversion Hmulti; subst; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma spine_inj : forall args args' c c',
  spine c args = spine c' args' -> c = c' /\\ args = args'.
Proof.
  induction args as [|a args IH]; intros [|a' args'] c c' H; simpl in H;
    try discriminate.
  - now inversion H.
  - injection H as Hf Ha. destruct (IH _ _ _ Hf) as (-> & ->). auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_spine : forall c c' args args',
  code_eq (spine c args) (spine c' args') ->
  c = c' /\\ Forall2 code_eq args args'.
Proof.
  intros c c' args args' (u & H1 & H2).
  destruct (code_steps_spine H1 c args eq_refl) as (xs & E & R).
  destruct (code_steps_spine H2 c' args' eq_refl) as (ys & E' & R').
  rewrite E in E'. destruct (spine_inj xs ys c c' E') as (-> & <-).
  split; auto. revert args' R'. induction R; intros args' R';
    inversion R'; subst; constructor; eauto. now exists y.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_lam_inv : forall t u, code_steps t u ->
  forall b, t = cl b -> exists b', u = cl b' /\\ code_steps b b'.
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros b ->.
  - exists b; auto with code.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Relations Relation_Operators.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Type constructors are represented by distinct constants in a lambda
   calculus. Runtime eliminators will use ordinary beta conversion. *)
Inductive consistency_constant : Set :=
| ct_type : sort -> consistency_constant
| ct_unit : consistency_constant
| ct_pi : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_wsigma : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_ssigma : grade -> consistency_constant
| ct_sum : consistency_constant
| ct_dummy : consistency_constant.

Inductive code : Set :=
| cv : nat -> code
| cc : consistency_constant -> code
| cl : code -> code
| ca : code -> code -> code.

Definition push {X : Type} (x : X) (f : nat -> X) (n : nat) :=
  match n with O => x | S m => f m end.

Fixpoint rename_code (f : nat -> nat) (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cv n => cv (f n)
  | cc c => cc c
  | cl b => cl (rename_code (push O (fun n => S (f n))) b)
  | ca a b => ca (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b)
  end.

Definition lift_code (f : nat -> code) :=
  push (cv 0) (fun n => rename_code S (f n)).

Fixpoint subst_code (f : nat -> code) (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cv n => f n
  | cc c => cc c
  | cl b => cl (subst_code (lift_code f) b)
  | ca a b => ca (subst_code f a) (subst_code f b)
  end.

Definition apply_body (b a : code) := subst_code (push a cv) b.

Local Lemma rename_code_ext : forall t f g,
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> rename_code f t = rename_code g t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g H; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  apply IHt. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_ext : forall t f g,
  (forall n, f n = g n) -> subst_code f t = subst_code g t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g H; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  apply IHt. intros [|n]; simpl; auto. now rewrite H.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_code_comp : forall t f g,
  rename_code f (rename_code g t) = rename_code (fun n => f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply rename_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_rename_code : forall t f g,
  subst_code f (rename_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_subst_code : forall t f g,
  rename_code f (subst_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => rename_code f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  now rewrite "'!rename_code_comp.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_comp : forall t f g,
  subst_code f (subst_code g t) = subst_code (fun n => subst_code f (g n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros f g; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite IHt. apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  now rewrite subst_rename_code, rename_subst_code.
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_id : forall t, subst_code cv t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; f_equal; auto.
  rewrite <- IHt at 2 || idtac.
  transitivity (subst_code cv t); [|exact IHt].
  apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma subst_code_unshift : forall a t,
  subst_code (push a cv) (rename_code S t) = t.
Proof. intros; rewrite subst_rename_code; apply subst_code_id. Qed.

Local Lemma subst_apply_body : forall b a f,
  subst_code f (apply_body b a) =
  apply_body (subst_code (lift_code f) b) (subst_code f a).
Proof.
  intros; unfold apply_body. rewrite !subst_code_comp.
  apply subst_code_ext. intros [|n]; simpl; auto.
  symmetry. apply subst_code_unshift.
Qed.

Inductive code_parallel : code -> code -> Prop :=
| cp_var : forall n, code_parallel (cv n) (cv n)
| cp_const : forall c, code_parallel (cc c) (cc c)
| cp_lam : forall b b'"', code_parallel b b' -> code_parallel (cl b) (cl b')
| cp_app : forall a a' b b',
    code_parallel a a' -> code_parallel b b' ->
    code_parallel (ca a b) (ca a' b')
| cp_beta : forall b b' a a',
    code_parallel b b' -> code_parallel a a' ->
    code_parallel (ca (cl b) a) (apply_body b' a').

Local Hint Constructors code_parallel : code.
Local Lemma code_parallel_refl : forall t, code_parallel t t.
Proof. induction t; auto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_parallel_refl : code.

Local Lemma code_parallel_rename : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> forall f, code_parallel (rename_code f t) (rename_code f u).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros f; simpl; auto with code.
  unfold apply_body. rewrite rename_subst_code.
  replace (subst_code (fun n => rename_code f (push a' cv n)) b')
    with (apply_body (rename_code (push 0 (fun n => S (f n))) b') (rename_code f a')).
  - auto with code.
  - unfold apply_body. rewrite subst_rename_code.
    apply subst_code_ext. now intros [|n].
Qed.

Local Lemma code_parallel_subst : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> forall f g,
  (forall n, code_parallel (f n) (g n)) ->
  code_parallel (subst_code f t) (subst_code g u).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros f g Hfg; simpl; auto with code.
  - apply cp_lam, IHcode_parallel. intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
    now apply code_parallel_rename.
  - rewrite subst_apply_body. apply cp_beta; auto.
    apply IHcode_parallel1. intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
    now apply code_parallel_rename.
Qed.

Fixpoint develop_code (t : code) : code :=
  match t with
  | cl b => cl (develop_code b)
  | ca (cl b) a => apply_body (develop_code b) (develop_code a)
  | ca f a => ca (develop_code f) (develop_code a)
  | t => t
  end.

Local Lemma develop_code_spec : forall t u,
  code_parallel t u -> code_parallel u (develop_code t).
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; simpl; auto with code.
  - destruct a; simpl in *; auto with code.
    inversion H; subst. inversion IHcode_parallel1; subst. auto with code.
  - unfold apply_body. apply code_parallel_subst; auto.
    intros [|n]; simpl; auto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_parallel_diamond : forall t a b,
  code_parallel t a -> code_parallel t b ->
  exists c, code_parallel a c /\\ code_parallel b c.
Proof. intros; exists (develop_code t); auto using develop_code_spec. Qed.

Local Definition code_steps := clos_refl_trans_1n code code_parallel.
Local Definition code_eq (a b : code) :=
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_steps b c.

Local Hint Constructors clos_refl_trans_1n : code.

Local Lemma code_steps_trans : forall a b c,
  code_steps a b -> code_steps b c -> code_steps a c.
Proof. intros a b c H; induction H; eauto with code. Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_strip : forall t a b,
  code_parallel t a -> code_steps t b ->
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_parallel b c.
Proof.
  intros t a b Ha Hb. revert a Ha. induction Hb; intros a Ha.
  - exists a; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_parallel_diamond Ha H) as (d & Had & Hyd).
    destruct (IHHb _ Hyd) as (e & Hde & Hze). exists e; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_confluent : forall t a b,
  code_steps t a -> code_steps t b ->
  exists c, code_steps a c /\\ code_steps b c.
Proof.
  intros t a b Ha; revert b; induction Ha; intros b Hb.
  - exists b; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_steps_strip H Hb) as (d & Hyd & Hbd).
    destruct (IHHa _ Hyd) as (e & Hze & Hde). exists e; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_refl : forall a, code_eq a a.
Proof. unfold code_eq; eauto with code. Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_sym : forall a b, code_eq a b -> code_eq b a.
Proof. unfold code_eq; firstorder. Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_trans : forall a b c,
  code_eq a b -> code_eq b c -> code_eq a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c (d & Had & Hbd) (e & Hbe & Hce).
  destruct (code_steps_confluent Hbd Hbe) as (f & Hdf & Hef).
  exists f; eauto using code_steps_trans.
Qed.
Local Lemma code_eq_parallel : forall a b, code_parallel a b -> code_eq a b.
Proof. intros; exists b; eauto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_eq_refl code_eq_parallel : code.

Local Lemma code_steps_lam : forall a b, code_steps a b ->

Proof. intros a b H; induction H; eauto with code. Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_app : forall a a' b b',
  code_steps a a' -> code_steps b b' -> code_steps (ca a b) (ca a' b').
Proof.
  intros a a' b b' Ha Hb. induction Ha.
  - induction Hb; eauto with code.
  - eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_lam : forall a b, code_eq a b -> code_eq (cl a) (cl b).
Proof. intros a b (c & Hac & Hbc); exists (cl c); auto using code_steps_lam. Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_app : forall a a' b b',
  code_eq a a' -> code_eq b b' -> code_eq (ca a b) (ca a' b').
Proof.
  intros a a' b b' (c & Hac & Hac') (d & Hbd & Hbd').
  exists (ca c d); auto using code_steps_app.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_rename : forall a b,
  code_eq a b -> forall f, code_eq (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b).
Proof.
  assert (H : forall a b, code_steps a b -> forall f,
    code_steps (rename_code f a) (rename_code f b)).

  intros a b (c & Hac & Hbc) f. exists (rename_code f c); auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_beta : forall b a, code_eq (ca (cl b) a) (apply_body b a).
Proof. auto with code. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve code_eq_lam code_eq_app code_eq_rename code_eq_beta : code.

(* A constant and its left-associated arguments survive every reduction.
   This gives both discrimination and injectivity for type constructors. *)
Fixpoint spine (c : consistency_constant) (args : list code) : code :=
  match args with
  | nil => cc c
  | a :: rest => ca (spine c rest) a
  end.

Local Lemma code_parallel_spine : forall args c u,
  code_parallel (spine c args) u ->
  exists args', u = spine c args' /\\ Forall2 code_parallel args args'.
Proof.
  induction args as [|a args IH]; intros c u H; simpl in H.
  - inversion H; subst. exists nil; auto.
  - destruct args; inversion H; subst;
      try solve [destruct args; discriminate].
    all: match goal with
    | Hp : code_parallel (spine _ _) _ |- _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    | Hp : code_parallel (cc _) _ |- _ =>
        change (code_parallel (spine c nil) _) in Hp;
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    | Hp : code_parallel (ca (spine _ _) _) _ |- _ =>
        change (code_parallel (spine c (_ :: _)) _) in Hp;
        destruct (IH _ _ Hp) as (args' & -> & Hargs)
    end.
    all: eexists (_ :: args'); split; [reflexivity|constructor; assumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_spine : forall t u, code_steps t u ->
  forall c args, t = spine c args ->
  exists args', u = spine c args' /\\ Forall2 code_steps args args'.
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros c args ->.
  - exists args; split; auto. induction args; auto with code.
  - destruct (code_parallel_spine args H) as (args' & Heq & Hpar).
    destruct (IHclos_refl_trans_1n _ _ Heq) as (args'' & -> & Hmulti).
    exists args''; split; auto.
    revert args'' Hmulti. induction Hpar; intros args'' Hmulti;
      inversion Hmulti; subst; eauto with code.
Qed.

Local Lemma spine_inj : forall args args' c c',
  spine c args = spine c' args' -> c = c' /\\ args = args'.
Proof.
  induction args as [|a args IH]; intros [|a' args'] c c' H; simpl in H;
    try discriminate.
  - now inversion H.
  - injection H as Hf Ha. destruct (IH _ _ _ Hf) as (-> & ->). auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_eq_spine : forall c c' args args',
  code_eq (spine c args) (spine c' args') ->
  c = c' /\\ Forall2 code_eq args args'.
Proof.
  intros c c' args args' (u & H1 & H2).
  destruct (code_steps_spine H1 c args eq_refl) as (xs & E & R).
  destruct (code_steps_spine H2 c' args' eq_refl) as (ys & E' & R').
  rewrite E in E'. destruct (spine_inj xs ys c c' E') as (-> & <-).
  split; auto. revert args' R'. induction R; intros args' R';
    inversion R'; subst; constructor; eauto. now exists y.
Qed.

Local Lemma code_steps_lam_inv : forall t u, code_steps t u ->
  forall b, t = cl b -> exists b', u = cl b' /\\ code_steps b b'.
Proof.
  intros t u H; induction H; intros b ->.
  - exists b; auto with code.
  - inversion H; subst. destruct (IHclos_refl_trans_1n _ eq_refl) as (b' & -> & Hb').
    exists b'; eauto with code.
Qed.

Proof.

Qed.

  code_eq b b' -> code_eq a a' -> code_eq (apply_body b a) (apply_body b' a').
Proof.
  intros. eapply code_eq_trans; [apply code_eq_sym, code_eq_beta|].
  eapply code_eq_trans; [apply code_eq_app; auto with code|apply code_eq_beta].
Qed.

item.text: The transitivity and injectivity cases need a stronger invariant than `Consistent` alone. I’ve proved confluence for a small lambda calculus and will use its conversion relation to track type constructors through definitional equality.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> Task.v <<'EOF'

(* Numeric scoping also applies to unopened bodies. *)
Local Fixpoint scoped (k : nat) (a : tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Pi _ a b | a_Abs _ a b | a_WSigma _ a b | a_SSigma _ a b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => scoped k a /\\ scoped (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b | a_WPair a _ b | a_SPair a _ b | a_Sum a b =>
      scoped k a /\\ scoped k b
  | a_Case _ a b c => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b /\\ scoped k c
  | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a | a_Proj1 _ a | a_Proj2 _ a => scoped k a
  | _ => True
  end.

Local Lemma scoped_mono : forall a k j,
  scoped k a -> (k <= j)%nat -> scoped j a.
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; intuition eauto with arith.
Qed.

Local Lemma scoped_open_rec : forall b k a,
  scoped (S k) b -> scoped k a -> scoped k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a b).
Proof.
  intro b; induction b; simpl; intros k a Hb Ha;
    try solve [intuition eauto using scoped_mono with arith].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl; auto; try lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma scoped_open_inv : forall b k a,
  scoped k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a b) -> scoped (S k) b.
Proof.
  intro b; induction b; simpl; intros k a H;
    try solve [intuition eauto].
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl in *; lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma lc_scoped : forall a, lc_tm a -> scoped 0 a.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; simpl; auto.
  all: split; auto; eapply scoped_open_inv with (a := a_Var_f fresh);
    unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in *; auto.
Qed.

Local Fixpoint tm_depth (a : tm) : nat :=
  match a with
  | a_Pi _ a b | a_Abs _ a b | a_WSigma _ a b | a_SSigma _ a b
  | a_App a _ b | a_WPair a _ b | a_SPair a _ b | a_Sum a b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => S (tm_depth a + tm_depth b)
  | a_Case _ a b c => S (tm_depth a + tm_depth b + tm_depth c)
  | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a | a_Proj1 _ a | a_Proj2 _ a => S (tm_depth a)
  | _ => 0
  end.

Local Lemma tm_depth_open_var : forall b k x,
  tm_depth (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) b) = tm_depth b.
Proof.
  intro b; induction b; intros k x; simpl; try now rewrite ?IHb, ?IHb1, ?IHb2, ?IHb3.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Hint Constructors lc_tm : scope_db.
Local Lemma scoped_lc : forall a, scoped 0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  assert (H : forall n a, tm_depth a < n -> scoped 0 a -> lc_tm a)%nat.
  { induction n as [|n IH]; intros a Hn Ha; [lia|].
    destruct a; simpl in *; try lia; try solve [constructor].
    all: constructor; intuition idtac;
      first [eapply IH; [simpl in *; lia|assumption]
            |intros x; eapply IH;
               [unfold open_tm_wrt_tm; rewrite tm_depth_open_var; lia
               |apply scoped_open_rec; simpl; auto]]. }
  intros a Ha; eapply H; [|eassumption]. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma lc_open : forall b a,
  scoped 1 b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b a).
Proof.
  intros; apply scoped_lc, scoped_open_rec; auto using lc_scoped.
Qed.

Scheme grade_ind_mut := Induction for Grade Sort Prop
  with cgrade_ind_mut := Induction for CGrade Sort Prop.
Scheme defeq_ind_mut := Induction for DefEq Sort Prop
  with cdefeq_ind_mut := Induction for CDefEq Sort Prop.

Local Lemma grade_scoped : forall P g a, Grade P g a -> scoped 0 a.
Proof.
  apply (grade_ind_mut (P := fun _ _ a _ => scoped 0 a)
    (P0 := fun _ _ _ a _ => scoped 0 a));
    simpl; intros; intuition eauto using lc_scoped.
  all: match goal with
  | H : forall x, x \\\\notin ?L -> scoped 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm _ _) |- _ =>
      pick fresh x for L; eapply scoped_open_inv; apply H; assumption
  end.
Qed.

Local Lemma defeq_scoped : forall P g a b, DefEq P g a b ->
  scoped 0 a /\\ scoped 0 b.
Proof.
  apply (defeq_ind_mut (P := fun _ _ a b _ => scoped 0 a /\\ scoped 0 b)
    (P0 := fun _ _ _ a b _ => scoped 0 a /\\ scoped 0 b));
    simpl; intros; intuition eauto using lc_scoped, grade_scoped, scoped_open_rec.
  all: match goal with
  | H : forall x, x \\\\notin ?L -> _ |- _ =>
      pick fresh x for L; specialize (H x ltac:(assumption))
  end.
  all: intuition eauto using scoped_open_inv, scoped_open_rec, lc_scoped.
Qed.
EOF

(* The runtime forms use Church pairs and injections. Type forms instead
   retain their constants, so conversion can recover their components. *)
Local Definition dummy := cc ct_dummy.
Local Definition pair_code a b :=
  ca (ca (cl (cl (cl (ca (ca (cv 0) (cv 2)) (cv 1))))) a) b.
Local Definition left_code a := ca (cl (cl (cl (ca (cv 1) (cv 2))))) a.
Local Definition right_code a := ca (cl (cl (cl (ca (cv 0) (cv 2))))) a.
Local Definition first_code a := ca a (cl (cl (cv 1))).
Local Definition second_code a := ca a (cl (cl (cv 0))).
Local Definition visible (g q : grade) (a : code) :=
  if q <=? g then a else dummy.
Local Definition shift_env {X : Type} (env : X -> code) :=
  fun x => rename_code S (env x).

Local Fixpoint translate (g : grade) (F : atom -> code)
    (B : nat -> code) (a : tm) : code :=
  let tr := translate g F B in
  let body b := cl (translate g (shift_env F) (lift_code B) b) in
  match a with
  | a_TyUnit => cc ct_unit
  | a_TmUnit => dummy
  | a_Type s => cc (ct_type s)
  | a_Var_b n => B n
  | a_Var_f x => F x
  | a_Pi q a b => spine (ct_pi q) (body b :: tr a :: nil)
  | a_WSigma q a b => spine (ct_wsigma q) (body b :: tr a :: nil)
  | a_SSigma q a b => spine (ct_ssigma q) (body b :: tr a :: nil)
  | a_Sum a b => spine ct_sum (tr b :: tr a :: nil)
  | a_Abs _ _ b => body b
  | a_App a q b => ca (tr a) (visible g q (tr b))
  | a_WPair a q b | a_SPair a q b => pair_code (visible g q (tr a)) (tr b)
  | a_LetPair _ a b => ca (tr a) (body b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => first_code (tr a)
  | a_Proj2 _ a => second_code (tr a)
  | a_Inj1 a => left_code (tr a)
  | a_Inj2 a => right_code (tr a)
  | a_Case _ a b c => ca (ca (tr a) (tr b)) (tr c)
  end.

Local Lemma translate_ext : forall a g F F' B B',
  (forall x, x "'`in` fv_tm_tm a -> F x = F'"' x) ->
  (forall n, B n = B' n) ->
  translate g F B a = translate g F' B' a.

Local Lemma translate_bound_ext : forall a g F B B' k,

Proof.
